summary: Tested the approved SLD in the dossier (positions 2 'schema' and 3 'fisa_tehnica'), finalize gating, the CIORNĂ export, approval history, the designer-set earth-resistance limit and remote signing of the approved schema. Backend: the new test_dossier_sld_iter9.py passes 12/12. Full regression: 100 passed, 1 intentional skip. Earlier, 7 regression tests were failing only because they were outdated (index shift from the new fisa_tehnica position, finalize now gated, docs/all no longer includes the old schema); I updated them. I found and fixed 1 backend bug and 2 frontend bugs. Results: positions 2 and 3 list 'Schema monofilară nu este aprobată...' while in draft. file/schema is 2 pages, landscape. fisa_tehnica returns a PDF. fmt=docx returns 400 for both. finalize returns 400 with the CIORNĂ message before approval and 200 after. The export is watermarked CIORNĂ (filename _CIORNA). After approval, file/schema and the export use sld.history[].file; I proved this by pointing the history file at a marker PDF. approve pushes history (revision, file, source) with current=true. A cef change makes the status stale and the entry current=false. Re-approval gives revision 1 and the old entry stays with current=false. Earthing: a missing limit is reported as missing; 5 Ω ≤ 10 Ω and 4.5 Ω ≤ 10 Ω are conform (no 4 Ω rule); 12 Ω > 10 Ω is an error, ready=false and approve returns 400. send-sign: 400 if not approved; 400 'Completați e-mailul...' if the staff has no email. On success it creates a schema request with status 'Link trimis', the correct sld_hash and a real email (Emergent email API returned 202). POST /sign/requests for schema returns 400 when not approved. Signing via the public OTP flow attaches the signed PDF with sld_hash. After a cef change, that upload is ignored and the 'Versiunea semnată anterior...' message appears (this works only after my opis.py fix). UI: staff-email and staff-phone save and persist. grid-ground-limit is present. SldPanel shows the history rows (current or previous version) and the send-sign buttons. The send-sign toasts work. Send-sign buttons are hidden when the approval is stale. GeneratedDocs has no schema entries.

critical.issue: FIXED by testing agent. When the signed schema's sld_hash no longer matched (cef changed), p.upload was set to None, but the local `o` still contained 'upload'. So auto_status was still 'atașat' and missing was cleared to []: the stale signed schema still counted as complete. Fix: strip both 'status' and 'upload' from o.

minor.issue: create_sign_requests stores opis.schema.status='necesită semnătură'. If the approval becomes stale before signing (no upload yet), this manual status stays, so the select shows 'necesită semnătură' while missing says 'anulată'. Consider clearing opis.schema/fisa_tehnica status when the fingerprint changes, or ignoring a manual status while the SLD is not approved.
The legacy old-schema endpoint still renders, and /docs/types still lists 'schema' and 'schema_cef'. The UI no longer exposes them; consider removing them for consistency.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: the Word (docx) icon was shown for positions 2 and 3 (schema/fisa_tehnica) and opened a raw 400 JSON. It is now hidden for these keys.

FIXED: clicking Finalizează while the SLD was not approved caused an unhandled promise rejection (Emergent error overlay) and no message. Added try/catch with toast.error(detail); the CIORNĂ message now shows.

issues: The send-sign button for a staff member without an email is enabled and labelled '(fără e-mail)'; clicking it only shows an error toast. Consider disabling it with a tooltip.

action_items: Review and keep the opis.py L132 fix (strip 'upload' from o when the signed schema hash mismatches).
Optionally reset the opis schema/fisa_tehnica manual status when the approval goes stale.
Optionally disable sld-send-sign-{role} when people[role].email is empty.
Optionally remove the legacy schema/schema_cef doc types.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1214 lines; consider splitting sld, sign and dossier routes into modules.
fingerprint() ignores rec-level grounding_limit (only cef.grid is hashed through cef, and top-level 'g' is grounding_ohm only). A limit stored at rec level would not invalidate the approval.
position_pdf falls back to a live render if an approved status has no matching history file (e.g. approvals that predate history); acceptable, but the version is then not frozen.
sld_send_sign uses the client-provided origin for the link without validation; consider deriving it from config or an allowlist.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ staff, client and prosumator records (pytest fixture and seed_sld_ui9.py) were cleaned up, along with their sign_requests. Verified 0 left.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run with: export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...; pytest tests/ (pytest.ini runs xdist -n 2; use -n0 for a single file). OTP signing in tests: set otp_hash=sha256('{id}:123456') in Mongo, then POST /public/sign/{token}/sign. seed_sld_ui9.py seed|clean creates an approved record whose designer email is the admin email.
rca of the issue: opis.build_positions: the invalidation branch nulled p['upload'] but rebuilt `o` without only 'status'. The later checks `o.get('upload')` (auto status) and `if o.get('upload'): p['missing']=[]` still saw the stale upload. Reproduction: approve, send-sign, sign, change cef, GET /dossier: position 2 showed atașat with missing=[]. Mitigation: exclude 'upload' from o.
